label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 18-under after final rounds of 64 and 60, sitting five strokes ahead of a six-way tie at 13-under including Sungjae Im, Kensei Hirata, Scottie Scheffler, and Wyndham Clark.

items.headline: Im’s Ace and Eagle
items.text: Sungjae Im aced the par-3 7th hole and eagled the par-5 9th to reach 13-under and share the 36-hole lead at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson earlier this week.

items.headline: Higgo Caddie Penalty Blame
items.text: Garrick Higgo’s caddie took responsibility for Higgo’s two-stroke PGA Championship penalty that caused him to miss the cut, leading to Higgo switching caddies at the Byron Nelson.
